name: NGC 5229 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5229, a late-type spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5229-hubble
story: A late-type spiral in the Canes Venatici I cloud of galaxies. Hubble visited it in an effort to resolve the brightest stars of every known nearby galaxy and measure how far away each one lies.

claims.text: NGC 5229 is a late-type spiral (type Sdm); PGC 47788
NGC 5229 is listed in the Canes Venatici I cloud
Hubble observed it in a program to image every known nearby galaxy, resolving the brightest stars to measure distances
